user.title: Nuvo Player Portfolio
user.description: Leave blank to search the network, or add zone IP addresses (or hostnames) if the amp is on another VLAN.

confirm.description: Add this Nuvo system? Zones found: {zones}.

error.no_zones: No Nuvo zones found. Check the zone is on and reachable, or enter its IP address.
error.invalid_host: Enter IP addresses or hostnames only, for example 192.168.1.52.

abort.already_configured: This Nuvo system is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not read the Nuvo zone.

line_in_feeds.title: Line In feeds
line_in_feeds.description: For each zone, pick the player wired to its Line In (for example a Chromecast Audio). When that player starts playing, the zone switches to Line In, turning on if needed. A zone listening to another zone's group is left alone. Leave a zone blank to skip it.

network.title: Network
network.description: Zone IPs are used for unicast discovery when multicast does not reach the amp. The event port is where zones send state changes; 0 picks a free port, so set a fixed one only if a firewall needs it.

error.invalid_host: Enter IP addresses or hostnames only, for example 192.168.1.52.

abort.not_loaded: The Nuvo system is not connected. Wait for it to load, then try again.
